3-coin-towers.description: Thirty paylines and three pagodas that grow through matching coins and lead to three different bonus modes.
3-coin-towers.feature: The green pagoda opens Free Games, the red one opens Coin Hold Bonus with jackpots, and the blue one opens a separate Pick’em Bonus.
3-coin-towers.note: This is more than a payline slot with several bonus buttons: collecting the appropriate coins determines which system develops next.
3-coin-towers.metricsNote: Endorphina's official game page confirms RTP 96.08%, high volatility, a 5×3 grid and 30 fixed paylines. The 1 000x figure specifically refers to the ULTRA Jackpot in Coin Hold Bonus when all 15 symbols are collected. It is not a stated overall maximum win for the game.

hell-hot-40.description: A conventional fruit slot with 40 paylines and a 5 × 4 grid. Special rules are kept to a minimum, making the payout structure easy to read from the grid.
hell-hot-40.feature: Wilds help form payline combinations. After an ordinary win, a separate Risk Game offers an attempt to increase the existing payout.
hell-hot-40.note: Hell Hot 40 is a useful straightforward reference: low volatility and conventional paylines do not mean a guaranteed result in a short session.
hell-hot-40.metricsNote: Endorphina's official game page confirms RTP 96.04%, low volatility, a 5 × 4 grid and 40 fixed paylines. Stacked Wilds and Scatters do not change the underlying payline mechanic, and Risk Game applies to a separate payout. The publisher does not publish an overall maximum win.

crown-coins.description: A compact 3 × 3 grid and five fixed paylines combine with prize coins, four jackpots and a separate Royal Treasury Bonus.
crown-coins.feature: Special coins carry their own values. The bonus system and four jackpots add a layer over a straightforward payline base.
crown-coins.note: The official volatility is Medium-High. Slotfolio's broader scale places the game in the High category.
crown-coins.metricsNote: Endorphina's official game page confirms RTP 96.06%, Medium-High volatility, a 3 × 3 grid and five fixed paylines. Royal Treasury Bonus contains four jackpot prizes up to 1 000x the total bet. This is the bonus potential, rather than a separately published overall fixed maximum win.

2026-hit-slot.description: Five reels, four rows and 50 paylines form the base for seven Hit Hold Bonus variants with Bonus, Collector and Payer symbols.
2026-hit-slot.feature: Special Diamond symbols open different Hit Hold combinations. Expanded modes add jackpots up to 2 000x the total bet.
2026-hit-slot.note: Separate ordinary payline payouts from the independent Hold and Win system: most of the complexity is in the bonus.
2026-hit-slot.metricsNote: Endorphina's current official game page lists Volatility: High, so Slotfolio retains the High category. At the same time, the official release dated 03.03.2026 calls the same game Ultra-High volatility. This discrepancy between sources is explicitly retained, rather than reduced to one unverified interpretation.
additionalSourceLabels: Endorphina release dated 03.03.2026 describing Ultra-High volatility

2021-hit-slot.description: A minimalist fruit slot on a 3 × 3 grid with five fixed paylines and almost no additional systems over the base game.
2021-hit-slot.feature: After an eligible win, a conventional Risk Game offers an attempt to increase the existing payout separately from the main spin.
2021-hit-slot.note: One of the catalogue's simplest examples: a way to examine the payline structure without numerous parallel features.
2021-hit-slot.metricsNote: Endorphina's official game page confirms RTP 96.02%, low volatility, a 3×3 grid and 5 fixed paylines. The publisher does not publish an overall maximum win, so none is listed.

2023-hit-slot.description: Six reels, four rows and 4 096 ways to win instead of fixed paylines. The bonus adds multipliers to Wild symbols.
2023-hit-slot.feature: Three or more Scatters trigger free spins. Wilds receive values of 2x, 3x or 5x, and several multipliers can apply to one combination.
2023-hit-slot.note: The name looks conventional, but the payout method is different: combinations are counted across adjacent reels, rather than predefined paylines.
2023-hit-slot.metricsNote: Endorphina's official game page confirms RTP 96.01%, high volatility, a 6×4 grid and 4 096 ways to win. The publisher does not state an overall fixed maximum win, so no value is invented.

2025-hit-slot.description: One hundred fixed paylines and stacked Wilds are supplemented by Gold Scatter Coins, which can move the round into a separate Coin Cascade and jackpot system.
2025-hit-slot.feature: In Hit Win Jackpots Bonus, coins stay fixed on a 5 × 3 grid. Five ULTRA Coins correspond to the Ultra Jackpot of 2 025x; additional coins increase the payout through a multiplier.
2025-hit-slot.note: Coin Cascade is the name of a bonus transition here, rather than an ordinary base-grid cascade mechanic. The game therefore remains in the payline category.
2025-hit-slot.metricsNote: Endorphina's official materials confirm RTP 96.05%, medium volatility, a 5×4 grid and 100 fixed paylines. The game's stated maximum payout is 2 025x the total bet.

prestige-crown.description: A 6 × 5 grid with scatter pays and cascades. Multipliers appear directly on the grid and behave differently in the base game and free spins.
prestige-crown.feature: Four or more Bonus symbols trigger 15 Free Games. Activated multipliers accumulate between winning cascades, and individual values can reach 1 000x.
prestige-crown.note: The round is defined by the cascade sequence and whether an overall bonus multiplier accumulates, rather than one large figure on screen.
prestige-crown.metricsNote: Endorphina's official materials confirm RTP 96.08%, high volatility, a 6×5 grid and scatter pays. Multipliers up to 1 000x refer to the accumulation mechanic in the game and Free Games. The publisher does not state an overall fixed maximum win.

lucky-streak-3.description: Three reels, three rows and five paylines: a compact fruit slot without a long sequence of additional rules.
lucky-streak-3.feature: The main additional feature follows a payout in Classic Risk Game. The grid itself remains conventional.
lucky-streak-3.note: Lucky Streak 3 is a useful base reference for comparing more complex games from the same publisher.
lucky-streak-3.metricsNote: Endorphina's official game page confirms RTP 96.01%, low volatility, a 3 × 3 grid and five paylines. A full screen of matching symbols multiplies the win by 2x, but this is not a stated overall maximum win. The publisher does not publish an overall cap.

lucky-streak-1000.description: Five paylines on a conventional 3 × 3 grid are supplemented by Diamond Mystery Bonus, four jackpots and a separate Risk Game.
lucky-streak-1000.feature: The diamond bonus adds choices and fixed prize levels over the base grid. Filling the screen with matching symbols doubles the corresponding payout.
lucky-streak-1000.note: Official Medium-High volatility is grouped into Slotfolio's High category to avoid dividing the catalogue into closely overlapping levels.
lucky-streak-1000.metricsNote: Endorphina's official game page confirms RTP 96.07%, Medium-High volatility, a 3 × 3 grid and five paylines. Diamond Mystery Bonus pays a jackpot up to 1 000x the total bet. This is the stated potential of a particular bonus, rather than a separately published overall fixed maximum win.
